South Korea Completes First Commercial Arctic Voyage to Europe

South Korea has successfully completed its first commercial voyage through the Arctic to Europe, utilizing the Northern Sea Route. The country aims to establish regular services on this route by 2030. This trial voyage marks a significant step in exploring alternative shipping lanes.
